words.word: for they shall be an ornament

occurrences.text: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
words: For they shall be an ornament

occurrences.text: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
